Your VaultInk reader, from the phone

VaultInk is the software on your e-reader that reads your Obsidian Vaults from its SD card. This app is its companion: it talks to the reader over Wi-Fi, so you can send it notes, manage its card and change its settings from the phone.
On the reader, open File Transfer and pick Join a Network (the same Wi-Fi as the phone) or Create Hotspot (then join the reader\'s Wi-Fi on the phone). Keep that screen open while you use the app.

Note: write a quick note or share text and pictures from other apps. It\'s saved on the reader\'s card right away; with LiveSync set up, the reader also sends it to your other devices on its next sync.
Files: the whole SD card. Upload, download, rename, move and delete.
Settings: the reader\'s settings, by category. Changes apply right away.
Device: the reader\'s address and firmware version, the LiveSync status, and app updates.
Convert a comic (in Files): Banana Comic Converter inside the app; the converted comic goes straight to the reader\'s Comics folder.
Bring notes in (in Note): a Google Keep export becomes Markdown notes in your vault.
Type into the reader (in Note): text you write here appears behind a From phone button in the reader\'s next text field. In Device, LiveSync can be asked to sync when you leave File Transfer.
Help (in the ⋮ menu): VaultInk\'s documentation, offline, with a search.

The app talks only to the reader on your Wi-Fi, and to GitHub when you ask it to check for an update. The comic converter runs from its own website only when you open it. No account, no tracking, nothing sent anywhere else.

The companion app for VaultInk, the Obsidian-vault firmware for the Xteink X4 Pro e-reader. It talks to the reader over Wi-Fi while File Transfer is open: quick notes and shares into a vault, the SD card, the reader\'s settings, comics, Keep imports and the LiveSync status, from the phone. Free software under the MIT licence.

Sync when I leave File Transfer
A sync can\'t run while File Transfer is open. This leaves a request on the card; the reader runs one sync when it wakes after you leave File Transfer.
Request left on the reader. Leave File Transfer there; the sync runs at its next wake.
Write here, send, then on the reader open a text field (a note line, a search, a habit name) and tap From phone to put the text in. Line breaks become spaces.
